title: Reuse a fix discovered through a past failure

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Host: valkyrie (compute). All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: valkyrie kept OOM-killing the vector-search service after the upgrade. We fixed it by raising vm.max_map_count to 262144 and restarting the service.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The generic advice online was to add swap space, which did not help.
setup.note: Wrong path that was tried; must not be reused.

probe.text: vector-search is getting OOM-killed on valkyrie after the upgrade again. What do I do?

expected.correct: raise vm.max_map_count to 262144 and restart vector-search
acceptable_variants: increase max_map_count to 262144 and restart the service
expected.rationale: The correct procedure is the environment-specific fix that worked before. The generic swap-space advice is a distractor and must not be offered as the fix.
